description:
Button roles are the next evolution of reaction roles, using buttons to apply roles instead of emojis.

You can create a message using Wynem that has buttons on it that users can click to add and remove roles from themselves.

data.title: Button roles!
fields: For updates and notices about Wynem
For whenever I update or release a resource pack
footer: Use the buttons below to apply the roles to yourself

description: There are multiple different types of button role that you can create.

rows: The user can add and remove "normal" roles as they wish
Once a user has applied a "binding" role, it cannot be removed
Users can only have one "unique" role from a button role message at a time

tabs.name: Creating Button Roles
content: To start setting up your own button roles, first run the e!buttonroles/role buttonroles command, and then click the button to start. The slash command skips this step and opens the form directly.

components: Press the button to start setting up the button roles

content:
Next, a modal will appear, where you can enter the information for the first role.
Fill in this modal and then click submit. Only the first field is required.

data.title: Button Role Builder
rows: The text that shows on the 1st role's button
The emoji that shows on the 1st role's button

rows.label: 1st Role Colour
rows.description: The colour of the role's button

rows.label: 1st Role Type
radios: The user can add and remove this role as they wish
Once the role is applied, it cannot be removed
You can only have one unique role at a time

content: You will then be given the option to add another role, or move on. Add any extra roles you may want, or skip this section.

components: Press a button to continue setting up the button roles

content:
Finally, you will be given a choice for the button role embed type. This decides how the button role message will look.
There are three options:

rows: Use the default button role embed, which is auto generated from the information provided for each button.
Create your own custom embed that can look however you want
Send no embed, the message will be just the buttons on their own

components: What embed type would you like for the button roles?

content: For a guide on creating custom embeds, check out the Custom Embed feature. You are finished! Your button roles have been created. Just click a button to receive/remove the designated role!

tabs.name: Removing Button Roles
content: To remove button roles, simply delete the button role message!
